plan.intro: The solver suggests the order of expenses that brings the most benefit, without ever going below the reserve. The committee remains free to approve the plan or not.
plan.chargement: Loading the solver (3.5 MB, first time only)…
plan.limiteTemps: Time limit reached: best plan found, not proven optimal.
plan.infaisable: No possible plan: the balance falls below the reserve even with no expense.
plan.erreur: The calculation could not be done:
plan.mois1: Only month 1 commits money. The following months will be reviewed at the next calculation.
plan.valide: Mock-up: the approval will be saved once the database exists.
plan.exemple: Example tasks, costs and donations, made up for the mock-up.

registre.intro: Every money movement is an entry. An entry is never changed or deleted: a mistake is corrected by an offsetting entry. Each entry is chained to the previous one by a fingerprint (hash).
